title: Welcome to Seldom
subtitle: A short conversation to personalize your workspace
welcome:
I'm **Seldom AI** — your assistant across tasks, goals, performance, and junior prep when you need it.

I'll ask a few quick questions to personalize your workspace. Each tab will introduce itself the first time you open it.

Nothing is pre-filled — your data starts when you add it.
completeMessage: You're set. Explore the sidebar — each section will say hello when you visit it for the first time.

steps.question: What should I call you in Seldom?

What's your main hobby, sport, or passion? This becomes the focus of your performance tab.

Be specific — e.g. **soccer** or **American football**, not just "football".
steps.placeholder: e.g. Soccer, American football, Piano, Rock climbing

steps.question: What short name should appear in the sidebar for that tab? (One or two words works best.)
What's your current focus in that area? Optional — type **skip** to leave blank for now.
steps.placeholder: e.g. Making varsity, Recording an EP

steps.question: Where are you in high school? This controls whether **Junior Prep** shows in the sidebar.
options: Neither — hide Junior Prep for now
